name: SHOPLINE
description: SHOPLINE stores (myshopline.com) through the Admin REST API: orders, fulfillments and tracking, transactions and refunds, products and variants, customers, locations and inventory levels. Private app access token.
instructions:
## SHOPLINE
This connector works with the **SHOPLINE Admin REST API** (the Open API of stores at `<handle>.myshopline.com`, version v20260901): orders, fulfillments and tracking, transactions and refunds (read-only), products and variants, customers, locations and inventory. It is not for the older SHOPLINE platform at shoplineapp.com, which has a different API.

**Setup (about 5 minutes)**
1. Log in to the SHOPLINE Admin at `https://admin.myshopline.com` and open **Apps**, then **Develop Apps** (top right), and create a private app.
2. Give it the access scopes the tools need: `read_orders`, `write_orders`, `read_products`, `write_products`, `read_customers`, `read_inventory`, `write_inventory`, `read_location`, `read_assigned_fulfillment_orders` and `write_assigned_fulfillment_orders` (read scopes alone are enough for the read tools).
3. Open the app's **API certificate** and copy the **access token** into `SHOPLINE_ACCESS_TOKEN`. A private app token is valid for 3 years and can be refreshed there; deleting the app revokes it.
4. Enter the store handle, the first part of `<handle>.myshopline.com`, in `SHOPLINE_HANDLE`.

**Where to start**: `shopline_list_orders` with `status` any (and `fulfillment_status` when you look for shipped orders), then `shopline_list_order_fulfillments`. For products `shopline_list_products`, `shopline_get_product` and `shopline_list_product_variants`.

**Orders**: `shopline_list_orders`, `shopline_count_orders`, `shopline_update_order` (tags, contact, notes, shipping address), `shopline_list_order_transactions`, `shopline_list_order_refunds`. The `id` is the order id; `name` is the order number the customer sees (1001 and up, with an optional prefix). Cancelling and refunding are not included, because they return money.

**Shipping**: `shopline_create_fulfillment` ships an order with a tracking number, `shopline_list_order_fulfillments` lists shipments, `shopline_update_fulfillment_tracking` replaces the tracking list of one shipment (send all entries, the rest is cleared).

**Products**: `shopline_list_products`, `shopline_get_product`, `shopline_count_products`, `shopline_update_product` (status active publishes, draft hides), `shopline_list_product_variants`, `shopline_update_variant` (price, compare-at price, SKU, barcode). Tags go in as a list and come back as a comma-separated string. Products have up to five options per variant.

**Customers**: `shopline_list_customers`, `shopline_get_customer`, `shopline_search_customers`, `shopline_list_customer_orders`.

**Stock**: each variant has an `inventory_item_id`. `shopline_list_locations`, `shopline_get_inventory_items`, `shopline_get_inventory_levels`, then `shopline_set_inventory` (absolute) or `shopline_adjust_inventory` (delta).

**Paging**: lists use a cursor. When there is another page, the answer carries `_pagination.nextUrl`; pass its `page_info` value with the same limit. `_pagination` is missing on the last page.

**Ids and formats**: ids are long digit strings (26 digits): always pass them as text. Times are ISO 8601; prices are decimal strings in the store currency.

**Rate limit**: 4 requests per second per app and store, with bursts up to 40 queued; above that SHOPLINE answers 429 `Too many request`. Answers are capped at 8 MB, so use `fields` and smaller limits for big stores.

SHOPLINE_HANDLE.label: Store handle
SHOPLINE_HANDLE.help: The first part of your store address: for open001.myshopline.com enter open001.
SHOPLINE_HANDLE.patternMessage: Enter only the handle in lower case, e.g. open001, without https:// and without .myshopline.com.

SHOPLINE_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Access token
SHOPLINE_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: SHOPLINE Admin, Apps, Develop Apps: open your private app, API certificate, and copy the access token.
SHOPLINE_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the access token (three parts separated by dots), without Bearer and without spaces.

401.hint: SHOPLINE refused the access token. Copy it again from Apps, Develop Apps, API certificate, or refresh it there if it expired.

verifyHints.403: The token works but the private app lacks the access scope for this call (for example read_orders or write_inventory). Add the scope to the app and copy the new token.

404.hint: SHOPLINE found no store, order, product or customer here. Check the store handle and the id.

verifyHints.rate_limited: SHOPLINE allows 4 requests per second per app and store (429 Too many request). Wait a moment and try again.

unreachable.hint: No SHOPLINE store answers at this handle. Check the first part of your myshopline.com address.

prerequisites: A SHOPLINE store (myshopline.com) and an admin account that may create private apps under Apps, Develop Apps. About 5 minutes.

tools.name: shopline_list_orders
tools.description: List orders: id, name (order number such as 1001), order_at, financial_status, fulfillment_status, status, currency, current_total_price, customer, line_items (product_id, variant_id, sku, title, quantity, price), shipping and billing address, fulfillments and refunds. Up to 100 per page; the next page is in `_pagination.nextUrl` (page_info cursor) and is missing on the last page.

status.description: open (in process), cancelled, or any (all, including archived).

fulfillment_status.description: Shipment status: unshipped, partial or shipped. SHOPLINE documents unshipped as the default, so pass shipped or partial explicitly to see those orders.

created_at_min.description: Only orders created at or after this time, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

created_at_max.description: Only orders created at or before this time, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

updated_at_min.description: Only orders updated at or after this time, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

updated_at_max.description: Only orders updated at or before this time, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

name.description: Order number as shown to the customer, with any custom prefix, e.g. 1001.

search_content.description: Free text: order number, payment serial number, tracking number, product name, SKU or amount.

sort_condition.description: Sort by order_at or id, asc or desc, comma-separated, e.g. `order_at:desc`.

since_id.description: Only orders after this order id.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to return, e.g. id,name,financial_status,current_total_price.

page_info.description: Cursor of the next or previous page: the page_info value of the URL in `_pagination.nextUrl` (or the `link` header) of the previous answer. Send it with limit only; other filters are ignored on a cursor page.

tools.name: shopline_count_orders
tools.description: Count the orders that match the filters (status, payment, shipment, dates): answers with count. Read-only.

financial_status.description: Payment status, e.g. paid or unpaid.

fulfillment_status.description: Shipment status, e.g. unshipped or shipped.

created_at_min.description: Created at or after, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

created_at_max.description: Created at or before, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

updated_at_min.description: Updated at or after, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

updated_at_max.description: Updated at or before, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

tools.name: shopline_update_order
tools.description: Change an order's tags, buyer email or phone, merchant notes (note_attributes) or shipping address. Only the fields given are sent; tags replace the existing tags.

order_id.description: Order id (id of shopline_list_orders, not the order number name), e.g. 21057850264845250791280282. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

tags.description: Order tags separated by commas; replaces the current tags.

note_attributes.description: Merchant notes, each with name and value.

shipping_address.description: New shipping address with first_name, last_name, address1, address2, city, province, province_code, country_code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), zip, phone and company.

tools.name: shopline_list_order_fulfillments
tools.description: List the fulfillments (shipments) of an order: id, status, tracking_company, tracking_number, tracking_url, line_items and created_at.

order_id.description: Order id (id of shopline_list_orders, not the order number name), e.g. 21057850264845250791280282. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

tools.name: shopline_create_fulfillment
tools.description: Ship an order (all of it, or the line items given) with a tracking number and carrier. notify_customer sends the shipping email. Answers with the new fulfillment.

order_id.description: Order id (id of shopline_list_orders, not the order number name), e.g. 21057850264845250791280282. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

tracking_company.description: Carrier name as in SHOPLINE's logistics company list, e.g. DHL or UPS.

line_items.description: Items to ship, each with id (the line item id of the order) and quantity. Leave out to ship everything open.

id.description: Line item id (line_items[].id of the order).

notify_customer.description: true: email the customer about the shipment.

tools.name: shopline_update_fulfillment_tracking
tools.description: Replace the tracking information of a fulfillment. The list replaces what is stored: tracking entries left out are removed.

order_id.description: Order id (id of shopline_list_orders, not the order number name), e.g. 21057850264845250791280282. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

fulfillment_id.description: Fulfillment id (from shopline_list_order_fulfillments), e.g. 4200000001. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

tracking_info_list.description: Tracking entries, each with tracking_number, tracking_company and tracking_url.

notify_customer.description: true: email the customer about the change.

tools.name: shopline_list_order_transactions
tools.description: List the payment transactions of an order: id, kind (sale, refund and so on), status, amount, currency, gateway and processed_at. Read-only.

order_id.description: Order id (id of shopline_list_orders, not the order number name), e.g. 21057850264845250791280282. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

tools.name: shopline_list_order_refunds
tools.description: List the refunds of an order: id, created_at, note, refund_line_items and transactions with amounts. Read-only.

order_id.description: Order id (id of shopline_list_orders, not the order number name), e.g. 21057850264845250791280282. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

tools.name: shopline_list_products
tools.description: List products: id, title, handle, status (active, draft, archived), vendor, tags, product_category, created_at, updated_at, options and variants (id, sku, price, compare_at_price, inventory_quantity, inventory_item_id). Up to 50 per page; the next page is in `_pagination.nextUrl` (page_info cursor).

collection_id.description: Only products of this collection id.

created_at_min.description: Created at or after, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

created_at_max.description: Created at or before, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

updated_at_min.description: Updated at or after, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

updated_at_max.description: Updated at or before, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

since_id.description: Only products after this product id.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to return, e.g. id,title,status,variants.

page_info.description: Cursor of the next or previous page: the page_info value of the URL in `_pagination.nextUrl` (or the `link` header) of the previous answer. Send it with limit only; other filters are ignored on a cursor page.

tools.name: shopline_get_product
tools.description: Read one product: title, body_html, status, vendor, tags, handle, options, images, media and variants with price, sku, barcode, weight, inventory_quantity and inventory_item_id.

product_id.description: Product id, e.g. 16057850264845250791280282. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

tools.name: shopline_count_products
tools.description: Count the products that match the filters (status, collection, dates): answers with count. Read-only.

collection_id.description: Only products of this collection id.

created_at_min.description: Created at or after, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

created_at_max.description: Created before, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

updated_at_min.description: Updated at or after, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

updated_at_max.description: Updated before, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

tools.name: shopline_update_product
tools.description: Change a product: title, subtitle, description (body_html), status (active publishes, draft hides, archived archives), vendor, tags, category or unlisted. Only the fields given change. Prices and SKUs are on the variants: use shopline_update_variant.

product_id.description: Product id, e.g. 16057850264845250791280282. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

unlisted.description: true: hidden from search and collections but reachable by link.

tools.name: shopline_list_product_variants
tools.description: List the variants of a product: id, sku, barcode, price, compare_at_price, option1 to option5, weight, inventory_quantity, inventory_policy and inventory_item_id. Up to 250 per page.

product_id.description: Product id, e.g. 16057850264845250791280282. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

page_info.description: Cursor of the next or previous page: the page_info value of the URL in `_pagination.nextUrl` (or the `link` header) of the previous answer. Send it with limit only; other filters are ignored on a cursor page.

tools.name: shopline_update_variant
tools.description: Change a variant: price and compare_at_price (decimal strings in the store currency), sku, barcode, weight with weight_unit, inventory_policy (whether it can be oversold) and inventory_tracker. Stock quantities change with shopline_set_inventory.

variant_id.description: Variant id, e.g. 18057850264845250791280282. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

compare_at_price.description: Original price shown crossed out, e.g. 24.90.

inventory_policy.description: continue allows overselling, deny stops at 0.

inventory_tracker.description: true: track stock for this variant.

tools.name: shopline_list_customers
tools.description: List customers: id, email, phone, first_name, last_name, state, tags, orders_count, total_spent, accepts_marketing, addresses and created_at. Up to 250 per page; next page in `_pagination.nextUrl`.

created_at_min.description: Created at or after, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

created_at_max.description: Created at or before, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

updated_at_min.description: Updated at or after, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

updated_at_max.description: Updated at or before, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-03T14:11:54+00:00.

page_info.description: Cursor of the next or previous page: the page_info value of the URL in `_pagination.nextUrl` (or the `link` header) of the previous answer. Send it with limit only; other filters are ignored on a cursor page.

tools.name: shopline_get_customer
tools.description: Read one customer: email, phone, names, state, tags, note, orders_count, total_spent, marketing consent and addresses.

customer_id.description: Customer id, e.g. 4201825024. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

tools.name: shopline_search_customers
tools.description: Search customers by name, email, phone or address text (query_param), or by exact criteria such as tags or orders_count (query). Same fields as shopline_list_customers; up to 250 per page.

query_param.description: Fuzzy text matched against phone, email, first_name, last_name, address1 and address2, e.g. smith.

query.description: Exact criteria as field:value separated by semicolons, e.g. `tags:vip;orders_count:3`. Fields: accepts_marketing, email_subscribe_flag, customer_date, customer_first_name, customer_id, tags, orders_count, order_date, state, total_spent, updated_at, verified_email.

order.description: Sort: 0 by creation time, 1 then by last order time, 2 then by order count, 3 then by id (all newest first).

page_info.description: Cursor of the next or previous page: the page_info value of the URL in `_pagination.nextUrl` (or the `link` header) of the previous answer. Send it with limit only; other filters are ignored on a cursor page.

tools.name: shopline_list_customer_orders
tools.description: List the orders of one customer, with the same order fields as shopline_list_orders. Up to 100 per page.

customer_id.description: Customer id, e.g. 4201825024. SHOPLINE ids are long digit strings: pass them as text.

since_id.description: Only orders after this order id.

page_info.description: Cursor of the next or previous page: the page_info value of the URL in `_pagination.nextUrl` (or the `link` header) of the previous answer. Send it with limit only; other filters are ignored on a cursor page.

tools.name: shopline_list_locations
tools.description: List inventory locations (warehouses and stores): id, name, address, active and whether it is the default location.

tools.name: shopline_get_inventory_items
tools.description: Read inventory items (one per variant): id, sku, tracked, cost and country of origin. The inventory_item_id is on every variant.

ids.description: Comma-separated inventory item ids (inventory_item_id of the variants).

tools.name: shopline_get_inventory_levels
tools.description: Read available stock per inventory item and location: inventory_item_id, location_id, available and updated_at.

inventory_item_ids.description: Comma-separated inventory item ids (inventory_item_id of the variants).

location_ids.description: Comma-separated location ids (from shopline_list_locations); all locations when left out.

tools.name: shopline_set_inventory
tools.description: Set the available stock of an inventory item at a location to an absolute number (replaces the current quantity).

inventory_item_id.description: Inventory item id (inventory_item_id of the variant).

tools.name: shopline_adjust_inventory
tools.description: Change the available stock of an inventory item at a location by a delta: positive adds, negative removes.

inventory_item_id.description: Inventory item id (inventory_item_id of the variant).

available_adjustment.description: Change in available quantity, e.g. 5 or -2.
